basic_details.short_information: IIT Kharagpur has one Junior Research Fellow vacancy in a Chemical Engineering research project on the surface of Venus. Applications are accepted online until 14 November 2026, and there is no application fee. The fellowship pays up to Rs. 37000 a month on a consolidated basis. Candidates need a qualifying degree and must have been selected through a national test such as CSIR-UGC NET or GATE, or through another national level examination.

application_fee.details: The notice also prints a fee account: State Bank of India (00202), P.O. Kharagpur Technology, account name IIT SRIC-OM Account, account number 39502115210, IFSC SBIN0000202 and SWIFT SBININBB339. It lists RTGS, NEFT and Net Banking among the payment methods.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The notice refers to an interview. The prescribed qualifications and experience are the minimum, and merely holding them does not entitle a candidate to be called for it.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: This is a temporary assignment in a purely time bound research project. The tenure is 36 Months or the termination of the project, whichever is earlier.

faq.question: Q1. What research will the Junior Research Fellow work on?
faq.answer: The project is titled "Modelling Venusian surface and surface morphology under a CO2 dominated dense atmosphere" and carries the code R/MVD.

faq.question: Q2. Who is sponsoring the project?
faq.answer: The sponsoring agency is the Space Applications Centre, Department of Space, Ahmedabad.

faq.question: Q3. Is a national level test required for this post?
faq.answer: Yes. Candidates must be selected through CSIR-UGC NET including lectureship (Assistant Professorship) and GATE, or through a national level examination conducted by bodies such as DST, DBT, DAE, DOS, DRDO, MoE, ICAR, ICMR, IIT, IISc, IISER or NISER.

faq.question: Q4. Can reserved category and female candidates get age relaxation?
faq.answer: Yes. The notice allows relaxation of up to 5 years for SC/ST/OBC/Physically Handicapped/Visually Handicapped and female applicants.

faq.question: Q5. How long will the fellowship last?
faq.answer: It runs for 36 Months or until the project terminates, whichever comes first.

faq.question: Q6. Does meeting the minimum qualification guarantee an interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that the prescribed qualifications and experience are only the minimum and do not by themselves entitle a candidate to an interview call.
